summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing the early redemption of all its Tier 2 Subordinated Financial Bills issued September 2021 and maturing September/October 2031, totaling BRL 11 billion. The bank will exercise its call option on September 21 and October 21, 2026. The repurchase is expected to reduce the Tier 2 capital ratio by approximately 70 basis points, calculated on the June 30, 2026 capital base. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for subsequent Tier 2 refinancing and capital ratio trajectory.
